name: vesper-claude-relay
description: A small Cloudflare Worker that lets the Vesper game call Claude with a key that never reaches the browser.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key (it starts with `sk-ant-`). Create one at [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys). It stays in this Worker; players never see it.

RELAY_PASSPHRASE.description: A passphrase you make up. You will paste it into the game, so only you can use this relay. Use a long random string, for example from `openssl rand -hex 16`.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Websites allowed to use this relay, separated by commas. Keep `https://theoi.github.io` to play on the official site.

ALLOWED_MODELS.description: Claude models the relay will forward, separated by commas.

MAX_TOKENS.description: The most output tokens one request may ask for. The game asks for about 120.

MAX_BODY_BYTES.description: The largest request the relay accepts, in bytes.
